takes_workspace.description: Whether attaching it requires a workspace.

RuntimeLifetime.description:
How the daemon reaches a runtime.

A value this build does not know reads as `spawned`.

oneOf.description:
Connected to the daemon on its own: a persistent runtime, or one a
client runs for as long as it does.
Started by the daemon from a `[runtimes.<id>]` template.

active_runs.description:
Active runs of sessions that attach the runtime (client protocol
1.55.0); `runtimes.disconnect` is refused while any run or
background call uses it. Always 0 for `global` and `local`.

background_calls.description: Background calls executing on the runtime (client protocol 1.55.0).

capabilities.description: What the runtime offers; empty until it has connected once.

connected.description: Whether the daemon holds a connection to the runtime now.

home.description:
The home directory the runtime reported when it last connected, as a
canonical absolute path on its machine (client protocol 1.7.0).
Clients show the paths of the runtime's attachments under it as `~/…`;
without one they show them absolute.

machine.description:
The machine the runtime belongs to: the one it is assigned to while
it is connected, else the one it is pinned to or the daemon last saw
it on (client protocol 1.10.0: remembered across restarts). Absent
while the daemon cannot tell.

message.description: Why the last attempt to connect failed, while it is not connected.

platform.description: The runtime's operating system, once it has connected and said.

description: The runtime afterwards, as `runtimes.list` reports it.
title: RuntimesConnectResult
